answer: Proposed gate: each ID supplies 1 kWh to orchard pumps per daily settlement horizon. A trusted meter signs disjoint ID/day energy receipts; a cipher hides them from outsiders. Validators decrypt and check signatures, binding, totals and nonreuse; failure denies listing. Energy is a recurring resource cost; panels are reusable capital; no stake. Cheap power weakens deterrence; meter fraud defeats it. With honest metering, ten IDs need 10 kWh/day: shared panels and parallel supply cannot reuse delivered energy.
